name: GitStage
description: Stages the given files for the next commit as they are in the working tree: a changed or new file is added, a deleted file is staged as deleted. Each path is read literally, relative to the working directory. The result is checked against the repository: nothing under the given paths may be left unstaged.
title: Stage {input.paths}

paths.description: The files or directories to stage

report: Nothing under {input.paths} is left unstaged. The index tree is {after.indexTree}.
